tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (7.8:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: stone-50
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.btn-primary`. 1.3:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: stone-500
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.nav a`, `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-label`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: stone-900
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo`, `.nav a:hover, .nav a.active`, `.page-title`. 13.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: sage-500
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo span`, `.stat-icon.sage`, `.card-badge`. 2.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-icon.terracotta`. 2.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: glass-white
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
